about: Remaining ordinary gateway writer lifetime coverage after channel home delegation removal. Implemented means registered, not passed; verdicts require results.

cases.what: Ordinary writers retain their detached lifetime; a cancelled promotion leaves the writer running, and each slot-holding runtime keeps its SIGTERM handler.
cases.evidence_scope: The gateway spawn and backend exit run in process with an isolated runtime root. The writer is hosted while awaiting gateway readiness. Existing managed writer tests independently cover actor and POST settlement. No delegated registry join is claimed.

mutants.name: ordinary_writer_joins_registry
mutants.at: runtime_bootstrap/o_writer_host.rs spawn and shutdown.rs finish_gateway_backend: restore registration and writer join
